comments:
He founded a dgon sde west of lCang ra and a bhos gzhis (sic) at rTa bres. See [647FFPZR]: 544, n. 57.
Known as one of the four spiritual sons of Pa tshab (ID:3868), along with Zhang Thang sag pa (ID:3870), rMa bya Byang chub ye shes (ID:6204), and Ngar/Dar Yon tan grags (ID:6211).
